name: distributed-reviewer-deferred-edge
body: source: the brief points the new reviewer file's owning component's `implemented-by` at `opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md`. Inconsistency (at spec time): that FQN did not resolve — `opencode-suite/agents/` held only the six existing prompts — and an `implemented-by` endpoint must be either real code or a planned FQN declared in the plan, so the edge could not be authored then (the write would have been refused). Resolution (LANDED): the plan-writer declared `opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md` as a planned File node under `agent-builder-roster-cleanup/plan` (status `planned`), so this reconciliation added `implemented-by solution.component.distributed-reviewer-prompt opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md` — now a pending planned target, not an error. The temporary edge to the read-guard coherence test `rust.main_e2e.e2e.installed_agent_prompts_state_file_access_read_guard` is KEPT: the change-set extends that test's five-prompt list to include `implementation-phase-reviewer.md` (requirement `requirements.requirement.reviewer-is-distributed-not-generated` AC 8), so the test is a genuine implemented-by of this component. Both `implemented-by` edges now stand. [with user — the brief explicitly sequenced plan-then-reconciliation]
